milestones.outcome: Select the Markdown dialect, safety and work bounds; provide one native reader verified against synthetic bodies.
exit_criteria: The overview, public-conversation and excluded Markdown surfaces are inventoried; dialect, renderer, effect ownership, bounds and integration contract are documented.
The shared native component renders the declared synthetic corpus, retains original source/copy, denies document resources and emits explicit link gestures without effects.
Focused keyboard, selection, fallback, unchanged-refresh, appearance/scale and measured large/pathological-document checks pass at the exact component candidate.
The design, acceptance frontier and continuation are durable, focused architecture/documentation checks pass and task-owned commands are quiescent.

The owner-requested comparison of md4qt and native Qt covers the declared GFM corpus, dependency/license/maintenance, resource boundary, measured bounded performance, native accessibility and source preservation, with a recorded renderer decision.
milestones.boundary: Component foundation only; keep BPR-0916 open for composed integration and all unsupplied native/human acceptance.

milestones.outcome: Integrate overview and public conversations, reconcile the expanded reader, and record full RFC acceptance through the shipped composition.
exit_criteria: Overview and public conversations render the declared subset through the shipped composition while preserving source, payloads, receipts and identities.
Admitted HTTP(S) link gestures traverse core/application policy and the host-owned browser capability; hostile resources and ambiguous relative references cause no automatic effects.
Native rendered keyboard/accessibility, light/dark/high-contrast and representative scale evidence covers source switching, selection, wide blocks and full final-content reachability.
Measured bounds, unchanged refresh and exact authority replacement are verified; all AC-01 through AC-06 evidence and documentation are recorded before dependency-eligible RFC closeout.
milestones.boundary: Close only accepted and dependency-eligible scope; preserve exact pending native/human decisions and prepare configured attended review if required.
